2607.24274.title: Physics-Guided Generative AI for Property-Targeted 3D Porous Media Design
2607.24274.paper_summary: Inverse design of three-dimensional porous media is central to applications in filtration, catalysis, energy storage, fuel cells, thermal management, and biomedical scaffolds, but remains challenging because many distinct pore geometries can share similar porosity or permeability while small structural changes can strongly affect transport behaviour. This paper proposes a physics-guided generative AI framework for property-targeted porous media design, combining a property-aware variational autoencoder, a conditional latent diffusion model, and an independently trained differentiable structure-to-property surrogate. The framework learns a compact, physically informative latent design space, generates porous structures conditioned on target porosity and directional permeability, and refines generated samples using property-level feedback during denoising and decoding. Experiments on procedurally generated structures and real micro-CT porous-media datasets show improved target-property matching, directional permeability control, and property correlation compared with representative property-aware variational-autoencoder and latent-diffusion baselines. The results demonstrate a scalable route towards controllable inverse design of complex porous geometries and establish a foundation for simulation-informed generative AI tools in engineering and advanced materials discovery.
2607.24274.paper_summary_zh: 三維多孔介質的逆向設計對於過濾、催化、能量儲存、燃料電池、熱管理和生物醫學支架等應用至關重要，但仍然具有挑戰性，因為許多不同的孔隙幾何形狀可以共享相似的孔隙率或滲透率，而小的結構變化可能會強烈影響傳輸行為。本文提出了一種物理引導的生成式人工智慧框架，用於針對性地設計多孔介質，結合了具有屬性意識的變分自編碼器、條件潛在擴散模型和獨立訓練的可微結構到屬性代理。該框架學習了一個緊湊且具有物理信息的潛在設計空間，根據目標孔隙率和方向性滲透率生成多孔結構，並在去噪和解碼過程中使用屬性級反饋來細化生成的樣本。對程序生成的結構和實際微CT多孔介質數據集的實驗顯示，與代表性的具有屬性意識的變分自編碼器和潛在擴散基準相比，目標屬性匹配、方向性滲透率控制和屬性相關性均有所改善。結果展示了一條可擴展的路徑，朝著可控的複雜多孔幾何形狀的逆向設計邁進，並為工程和先進材料發現中的模擬引導生成式人工智慧工具奠定了基礎。
2607.24274.author: Peng Wang et.al.
